entries.name: Village green
entries.description: Open village green with a broad crossing gravel path, three broad-canopy mature trees, simple1.2m boundary fence and one small play structure. Grass gaps remain transparent to reveal terrain; no flower dots.

entries.name: Formal gardens
entries.description: Open formal garden with broad cross paths, one readable round fountain, large hedge masses and four mature trees. Fence1.2m, fountain2m tall, ordinary benches; no fine ornamental beds.

entries.name: Woodland park
entries.description: Open woodland park with six ordinary mature trees7m tall, a curved broad path and a compact blue pond. Trees do not become gigantic because the parcel is3x3. Transparent gaps between tree clusters.

entries.name: Neighbourhood shopping centre
entries.description: A low neighbourhood retail court made of four distinct small one-storey shops around a broad open plaza, alternating simple warm roofs and broad awnings; every shop has a normal2.1m door.

entries.name: Shopping mall
entries.description: A broad two-storey brick shopping arcade with two low wings and a central glass barrel skylight. Small normal2.1m entrance doors, repeated3m floors, one large4.2m loading dock; no tiny sign grids.

entries.name: Modern shopping mall
entries.description: A broad low contemporary mall: two3m storeys, timber-and-pale-stone facades, broad glazing, one big skylight and two broad green-roof sections with a clean solar-panel mass. Normal2.1m doors.

entries.name: Grocer
entries.description: Traditional two-storey grocer: timber-and-plaster facades, broad slate roof and muted green awning; one display window, no tiny produce crates.

entries.name: Bakery
entries.description: Traditional two-storey timber bakery with a strong terracotta gable and broad ochre awning; no individual roof tiles, planks, lettering or bread loaves.

entries.name: Butcher
entries.description: Traditional one-storey stone butcher with warm terracotta roof and broad red awning, ordinary2.1m door; no tiny hanging meats or fine signs.
